arw-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：阿拉德机场的跑道铺在罗马尼亚西部的平原上，航站楼与机坪在跑道一侧，周围是城市与农田。
arw-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Arad's runway lies on the western Romanian plain, with the terminal and apron alongside it and city and farmland around.

arw-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 暮色中，阿拉德机场航站楼的蓝色外墙上亮着Aeroportul Arad招牌，前方广场上行人往来。
arw-chatgpt-01.webp.en: At dusk the blue facade of Arad Airport glows with its Aeroportul Arad sign, and travellers cross the wide concrete forecourt below.

arw-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 晴朗的天空下，一架客机正朝跑道进近，机坪上印有ARAD AIRPORT字样的登机梯静候一旁。
arw-chatgpt-02.webp.en: A passenger jet descends towards the runway under fair-weather clouds while ground equipment and ARAD AIRPORT boarding stairs wait on the apron.

arw-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 机坪上并排停着几架客机，其中一架紫红色机身写有wizzair.com字样，地勤在旁作业。
arw-chatgpt-03.webp.en: Several airliners share the apron, a magenta jet lettered wizzair.com in front and a white Moldavian aircraft behind, as ground staff work the stairs.

arw-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 航站楼内的值机大厅空旷明亮，头顶蓝色指示牌用罗马尼亚语和英语标注值机与登机口方向。
arw-chatgpt-04.webp.en: The check-in hall stands empty and bright, its blue overhead sign pointing to check-in and gates in Romanian and English.

arw-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 跑道中央的白色箭头标记与两侧灯光延伸向灰白的远方天际，路面可见轮胎痕迹。
arw-chatgpt-05.webp.en: White chevrons and runway edge lights recede towards a pale, hazy horizon, with tyre marks darkening the concrete surface.

arw-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 蓝天下，一架白色双发螺旋桨飞机静静停在水泥机坪上，长影子投在脚下。
arw-chatgpt-06.webp.en: Under a cloudless blue sky, a white twin-prop airliner stands parked on the concrete apron with a long shadow beneath it.

arw-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 机坪上的白色客机接上写有ARAD AIRPORT的登机梯，一辆黄黑格纹的引导车停在前面。
arw-chatgpt-07.webp.en: A white narrow-body jet is connected to ARAD AIRPORT boarding stairs while a yellow-and-black checkered follow-me car waits in front.
